request.voice_description: An original male Italian video-game fighter, age 35. Warm raspy mid-low tenor, bright forward resonance, rolling Rs, recognisable Italian accent in English with musical Italian vowels and lively rising-falling rhythm. Charming, cocky and theatrically expressive, with sudden explosive anger. Speak fluent intelligible English with short naturally pronounced Italian interjections. A physical action-game performance, compact energetic delivery, not a narrator. Clean dry close microphone, no music, no background, no reverb. No imitation of a real person.
request.text: [confident] Andiamo! Rocco is here, and this fight needs a little style. [annoyed] Mamma mia, my armor is melting! [taunting] Come closer, stronzo. I promise you a beautiful defeat.
